issues.description: Numeric threshold for Aufgabe 07 is inconsistent between problem statement and solution. The problem statement (problem_statement.md) requires selecting Gemeinden with more than 75,000 male or more than 75,000 female inhabitants (written as "75.000" in the text). The solution (solution_repository/aufgabe07.sql) uses the numeric literal 7500 in the WHERE clause (einwohner_m > 7500 OR einwohner_w > 7500), which is an order-of-magnitude lower and will return a different set of Gemeinden. This mismatch will confuse students about the correct threshold to implement and causes the reference answer to be incorrect relative to the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the numeric threshold consistent. Update solution_repository/aufgabe07.sql to use 75000 (not 7500) in the WHERE clause: WHERE einwohner_m > 75000 OR einwohner_w > 75000. Alternatively, if 7,500 was intended, update the problem statement to state 7.500 (or explicitly 7500) so both artifacts match.
